p: A single blistering lap feels great, but it's consistent laps that win races. When you watch the experienced drivers, you'll see they hit the same spots corner after corner, lap after lap, without drama. That's the goal.

Pick a braking marker for each bend and use it every time. Try one change at a time, maybe braking a touch later or turning in a little earlier, then check the timing screen to see whether it helped. Treat it like an experiment and you'll be amazed how quickly the times come down.
Keep an eye on traffic too. Getting stuck behind a slower kart can wreck a lap, so a clean overtake is worth more than holding back.
Dundee railway station sits right by the waterfront, so arriving by train is easy, and the V&A and Discovery Point are only a stroll away.

Once the racing's done, Dundee has loads to offer. Broughty Ferry, a short trip along the coast, has a sandy beach and a castle right on the water, perfect for a breath of sea air. The McManus art gallery and museum in the city centre is housed in a gorgeous Gothic building, and Verdant Works tells the story of the city's jute industry, which once made Dundee famous worldwide.
